assets.storyBeat: Canonical system map: two source coordinate systems converge through the Tally evidence pipeline, emitting a typed event to the cockpit and verified enrichment back to DataHub.
assets.intendedConclusion: DataHub context and commit-pinned repository evidence join in a deterministic pipeline. Mismatch, ambiguity, and incomplete evidence become explicit gaps or refusals, never silent zeroes.

assets.proposedAltText: Tally architecture: DataHub context (URN, schema, lineage, owners) and repository snapshot (workspace.json, source tree, pinned commit) feed the six-stage Tally evidence pipeline (read, attest, resolve, validate, enrich, observe). A guardrail bar marks that mismatch, ambiguity, or incomplete evidence becomes an explicit gap or refusal, never a silent zero. Verified enrichment writes back to DataHub. A controlled plan comparison runs the same task, model, and settings with DataHub-only versus joined context. The pipeline emits a typed ChangeImpactEvent 1.3 to the Change Impact Cockpit (impact, change plan, receipts).
assets.proposedCaption: Two coordinate systems, one deterministic join, a typed event, and a writeback receipt.
